title: Maternal Health Basics
description: Learn about the essentials of maternal health, including prenatal care, nutrition, and warning signs during pregnancy.

subContent.text: Prenatal care is essential for monitoring the health of both mother and baby. Regular checkups help detect and prevent potential complications.
Watch this video to understand the importance of nutrition during pregnancy.
Be aware of warning signs such as severe headaches, vision changes, or swelling. Seek medical attention if these occur.

title: Immunization Schedule
description: Understand the national immunization schedule for children and mothers, including timing and importance of each vaccine.

subContent.text: Immunization protects children and mothers from serious diseases, preventing illness, disability, and death. It's a cornerstone of public health.
Follow the national immunization schedule for children from birth to 5 years, including vaccines like BCG, DPT, Polio, Measles, and more.
Pregnant women should receive Tetanus-Diphtheria (Td) or Tdap vaccine to protect themselves and their newborns from life-threatening diseases.

title: Newborn Care
description: Best practices for newborn care, breastfeeding, hygiene, and early danger signs to watch for in infants.

subContent.text: Essential care immediately after birth includes ensuring warmth, drying the baby, promoting skin-to-skin contact, and initiating breastfeeding early.
Exclusive breastfeeding for the first six months provides optimal nutrition, strengthens immunity, and fosters bonding between mother and baby.
Learn about proper umbilical cord care, safe bathing techniques, and ensuring a safe sleeping environment to prevent infections and accidents.
Key danger signs in newborns include difficulty breathing, fever, lethargy, poor feeding, and convulsions. Seek medical help immediately if these are observed.

Sleeping peacefully for a few hours

title: Family Planning
description: Overview of family planning methods, counseling techniques, and addressing common myths and misconceptions.

subContent.text: Family planning empowers individuals to decide the number, spacing, and timing of their children, significantly improving maternal and child health outcomes.
Explore various modern contraceptive methods like pills, injectables, IUDs, condoms, and permanent methods, understanding their effectiveness and proper usage.
Effective counseling involves active listening, providing accurate and unbiased information, and respecting the client's informed choices regarding family planning.
Learn to identify and address common myths and misconceptions about family planning methods to ensure that individuals make informed decisions based on facts.
